request.style: English, children's song, children's choir with cheerful male lead, ukulele, glockenspiel, hand claps, bouncy bass, light drums, sing-along, 116 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
When the sun comes up and I open my eyes
I can see the morning in the bright blue sky
I stretch up tall and I jump out of bed
I remember what the Bible said

[Chorus]
This is the day the LORD has made
Let us rejoice and be glad in it
This is the day the LORD has made
Let us rejoice and be glad in it

[Verse]
Clap, clap, clap when the sun is high
Stomp, stomp, stomp when the rain comes by
Turn around and jump and sing
God has made each day and everything

[Chorus]
This is the day the LORD has made
Let us rejoice and be glad in it
This is the day the LORD has made
Let us rejoice and be glad in it

[Bridge]
Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday
Friday, Saturday, Sunday too
Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good
His steadfast love endures forever

[Chorus]
This is the day the LORD has made
Let us rejoice and be glad in it
This is the day the LORD has made
Let us rejoice and be glad in it

[Outro]
Rejoice and be glad
Rejoice and be glad in it
